# Week 7 Start/Sit Briefing -- Saturday, 2026-10-24

**Final designations are set. 28 of 32 teams have filed live injury reports, including all 12 teams relevant to this roster, and none of the 15 rostered players carries a designation. This is a clean lock.**

## Source and freshness

- Primary: committed fixture `weekly-report-week-7.json`, generated 2026-10-20T14:31:42Z (FantasyPros consensus + ESPN injuries + the fitted P(play) model). Confirmed current: generated after Week 6's finale and before Week 7's first kickoff; `season_week.load_current_week_nflreadpy(2026)` independently agrees it's Week 7.
- Overlay: live `nflreadpy.load_injuries(2026)` for Week 7 -- 28/32 teams filed (up from 2 on Wednesday). All 12 of this roster's NFL teams have filed. Result: zero changes to any projection. Taylor, Irving and Shough show Full Participation with no designation (healthy, just tracked); everyone else has no row at all, which at this point in the week means healthy, not unreported.

## Start these ten -- 141.52 expected points

| Slot | Player | Opp | Expected | P(play) | If he plays |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| QB | Matthew Stafford | @LV, Sun 4:25pm | **18.69** | 97.0% | 19.27 |
| RB | Jonathan Taylor | @MIN, Sun 1:00pm | **16.61** | 95.2% | 17.45 |
| RB | Bucky Irving | @CAR, Sun 1:00pm | **13.92** | 95.2% | 14.63 |
| WR | Jaxon Smith-Njigba | vs KC, Sun 8:20pm | **21.43** | 96.8% | 22.15 |
| WR | Drake London | vs SF, Sun 1:00pm | **16.07** | 96.8% | 16.61 |
| TE | Sam LaPorta | vs GB, Sun 4:25pm | **12.28** | 94.4% | 13.02 |
| FLEX | Tee Higgins | @BAL, Sun 1:00pm | **13.34** | 96.5% | 13.82 |
| FLEX | Jalen Coker | vs TB, Sun 1:00pm | **12.76** | 94.5% | 13.51 |
| K | Dominic Zvada | @HOU, Sun 1:00pm | **8.13** | 98.5% | 8.25 |
| DEF | Jets D/ST | vs MIA, Sun 1:00pm | **8.29** | 100% | 8.29 |

Bench, for reference: Tyler Shough (QB, 16.86 exp), Bo Nix (QB, 19.51 exp but see note below), Cam Skattebo (RB, 10.40 exp), Jameson Williams (WR, 11.28 exp), Isaiah Likely (TE, 11.84 exp). All healthy, none close enough to force a change except the QB question addressed below.

## The one real judgment call: Stafford over Nix

The fixture's raw number says bench QB Bo Nix (19.51) outprojects started QB Matthew Stafford (18.69) by 0.82. That number is FantasyPros' top-10 consensus tier, and it has not caught up with Nix's actual 2026 form: 12.1 points/game on the season, 8.7 over his last three starts, 4.0-5.1 yards per attempt. You already found this and reversed a same-day Nix-for-Stafford swap on 10/22 for exactly this reason. **Recommendation: keep Stafford started.** The consensus gap is noise from a stale vendor number, not signal.

## Changes since Wednesday's briefing (10/21)

1. **DEF: Jaguars -> Jets D/ST (+8.29).** Jaguars were on their Week 7 bye and scored zero as started in the 10/21 report -- the hole flagged in both the 10/19 and 10/21 briefings. A 10/22 waiver move (Jaguars D/ST for Jets D/ST) fixes it outright.
2. **TE: Isaiah Likely -> Sam LaPorta (+0.44).** The 10/21 briefing held Likely over a thin, 0.44-point LaPorta edge, calling it noise and flagging it for a re-check. The edge has now held across two straight reports, so LaPorta starts.

Net: lineup total moves from 132.79 (Wednesday, with the DEF hole) to 141.52 -- an 8.73-point gain, which is exactly the sum of the two changes above (8.29 + 0.44), confirming nothing else moved.

## Watch list

Nothing to watch. No rostered player carries an Out/Doubtful/Questionable designation, and this is the last injury-report cycle before Sunday's games -- any further movement this week would be a late scratch, not a practice-report change.

## Opponent notes

- Jaxon Smith-Njigba's game (vs KC) is the Sunday Night finale -- the last score in the lineup to land, and the highest single projection on the roster (21.43).
- See the Stafford/Nix note above -- the one place a vendor number and real-world form disagree this week.

## Byes ahead

**Week 8 is a real problem, not a watch item: four rostered players bye the same week.** Dominic Zvada (K -- the *only* rostered kicker), Tyler Shough (QB), Cam Skattebo (RB) and Isaiah Likely (TE) are all out Week 8. With only 5 bench spots, this needs a waiver claim before Wednesday, especially at kicker: the Week 8 fixture's waiver pool currently lists exactly one K option, Drew Stevens (WAS, 6.54 projected), itself flagged as a thin, no-games-played speculative add. Start looking now rather than waiting for Monday -- the pool may still be weak then too.
